label: Podcast Player
description: A branded, accessible episode player for Hugh McNeill podcast audio, related maker context, external listen links, transcript prompts, and connected object shelves.

trustedOpenSource.purpose: Accessible, brandable native media controls for audio and video playback.

fields.name: episode
fields.note: Episode slug, number, or Directus relation key.

fields.name: audio_url
fields.note: Direct audio URL from Podbean/RSS or uploaded Directus file URL. No embed JavaScript.

accessibility: Use native audio semantics and labelled controls.
All play, pause, seek, mute, and transcript controls must be keyboard operable.
Visible focus states are required for every control.
Provide a text transcript or transcript link where available.
External listen links must be plain anchors with readable labels.
bespoke_gap: shadcn provides buttons, cards, and layout primitives, but it does not provide accessible native audio playback controls, seek/progress controls, or media controller semantics. Media Chrome is the trusted MIT-licensed open-source media-control package for this gap; CMS content stores only data such as audio URLs, episode metadata, transcript text, and related content slugs.

checks.reason: Slots are inside the tenant page-slot contract.
Podcast/audio playback uses the trusted Media Chrome package rather than arbitrary embeds.
